It looks like you combined several distinct terms or misspelled a brand name (such as
Noweda
, a major German pharmaceutical wholesaler, rather than a specific device manufacturer). If you are looking for medical and consumer health tech, these devices fall into distinct categories for
tracking wellness and managing chronic conditions
GRG Health
Core Health Tech Categories
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Wearable sensors (like the Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom) stick to your skin. They test fluid under your skin to track sugar levels 24/7.
PubMed Central (PMC) (.gov)
Smartwatches:
Wrist devices that track steps, daily activity, and basic heart metrics. Some advanced models feature optical sensors or basic on-demand electrical checks.
World Health Expo
Wearable ECG:
Specialized patches or smartwatches that record heart rhythms. They help find irregular heartbeats like atrial fibrillation.
VivaLNK
Sleep Trackers:
Rings, bands, or watches that measure rest quality, breathing, and sleep stages.
GRG Health
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Home systems that securely send your daily vitals—like blood pressure or glucose—straight to your doctor.
PubMed Central (PMC) (.gov)
